item.title: Quple 0.1.3
item.description:
Crossed calls: calling someone who's ringing you answers their call

If both people press call at once (or you call back instead of
answering), /call no longer opens a second room: it answers the other
person's ringing call on your device and returns its meeting with
"joined": true. The desktop and iPhone apps go straight into it and stop
that call ringing as answered, not declined.
